caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur oriented horizontally, with the rowel (the rotating, star-shaped wheel) on the left side of the image. The spur is predominantly rendered in dark brown and black tones, giving it a metallic appearance. The rowel is large, circular, and has multiple pointed edges. The body of the spur curves around in an arc, forming a U-shaped frame with three rounded protrusions, two on the bottom and one on top, likely representing attachment points for straps. The background is plain and light-colored, providing a stark contrast to the darker object, and there is a small signature in the lower right corner reading "R. Wilk. Teixeira."
title: Spur
